The '''Sellasas system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
